title: All "except" blocks should be able to catch exceptions
description: An except block that cannot catch any exceptions is misleading and serves no purpose. This can happen if the except block specifies an exception type that cannot be raised by the try block, or if the block is unreachable. Such code is confusing and should be removed or corrected.
message: This except block cannot catch any exceptions. Review the exception type or remove unnecessary code.

impact.reliability: Medium impact on code correctness and exception handling logic
impact.maintainability: High impact on code clarity and developer understanding

recommendation: Remove unreachable except blocks or correct the exception type to match exceptions that can actually be raised by the try block.

noncompliant.description: Except block that can never catch anything due to wrong exception type
noncompliant.code:
try:
    result = int("hello")
except KeyError:  # ValueError will be raised, not KeyError
    print("This will never execute")

noncompliant.description: Unreachable except block after broad exception handler
Except block for exception that code cannot raise
Multiple except blocks with inheritance issues

compliant.description: Proper exception handling with correct exception types
Correct order of exception handlers (specific to general)
Exception handling that matches possible exceptions

why_is_this_an_issue: Unreachable except blocks create several problems: (1) They mislead developers into thinking certain exceptions are being handled when they're not, (2) They add unnecessary complexity to the code, (3) They can hide real bugs in exception handling logic, (4) They make code reviews more difficult as reviewers must determine which except blocks are actually reachable, (5) They can create false confidence in error handling coverage during testing.

how_to_fix.description: Analyze the code in the try block to identify what exceptions can actually be raised
Review the order of except blocks - more specific exceptions must come before general ones
Remove except blocks that handle exceptions that cannot be raised by the try block
Reorder except blocks so that specific exceptions come before their parent classes
Consider using 'except Exception as e' for general error handling instead of multiple unreachable blocks
Test the exception handling to ensure all paths work as expected
